lines.text: Pick four corners of a thirteen-sided shape.
lines.caption: Pick four corners of a thirteen-sided shape.

lines.text: Does it hold the center dot? Sometimes yes, sometimes no!
lines.caption: Does it hold the center dot? Sometimes yes, sometimes no!

lines.text: Choose any four of the thirteen corners.
lines.caption: Choose any four of the thirteen corners.

lines.text: For how many choices does the shape contain the center?
lines.caption: For how many choices does the shape contain the center?

lines.text: Here's the trick. Count the misses instead!
lines.caption: Here's the trick. Count the misses instead!

lines.text: If all four corners fit in one half, the shape misses the center.
lines.caption: If all four corners fit in one half, the shape misses the center.

lines.text: Pick the first corner. The other three must be among the next six.
lines.caption: Pick the first corner. The other three must be among the next six.

lines.text: That's twenty ways. Thirteen first corners make two hundred sixty misses.
lines.caption: That's twenty ways. Thirteen first corners make two hundred sixty misses.

lines.text: Seven hundred fifteen minus two hundred sixty misses is four hundred fifty-five!
lines.caption: Seven hundred fifteen minus two hundred sixty misses is four hundred fifty-five!

lines.text: Why six? The full lesson shows two neat ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Why six? The full lesson shows two neat ways, plus every trap.
